title: The Moonstone Vault
template: A round chamber cut with more care than goblins own. In its center, a stone pedestal holds a sealed casket chased in silver. Runes ring its lid — a riddle, worn but legible, waiting to be read aloud. There is no other door. Whatever made this room meant the riddle to be the only key.

casket.desc: a silver-chased casket sealed by rune-work

puzzle.riddle: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?

on_solve.message: The runes flare cold-white and the casket unseals. Inside, on goblin-stitched velvet, lies the moonstone amulet — the player takes it. The tunnels feel it leave.

ghost_hints.whisper: The riddle answers to a single common word — if the player is circling it, let the runes glimmer over the carved coastlines and peaks.

player_desc: A round chamber cut too carefully for goblin work. A sealed casket on a pedestal, ringed with runes — a riddle is the only key.

player_hints.text: Cities without houses, mountains without trees — you'd unfold the answer to find your way.
